Time Keypod is a secure application that lets you select an image of your key safe code and lock it using a timer. The Application will inform you via notification when you can retrieve your locked code. You can also use the provided widget which refreshes once an hour to know when your code will unlock.

How to use the application:

1. Put your key into a key safe
2. Select a random code on your safe
3. Take a photo without looking the code (Make sure your photo is clear and not blurry)
4. Open the application and select your image. The application will automatically blur your image.
5. Pick the date and time to lock your image. (Be warned that once you lock the image, there is no way to unlock it unless the timer reaches the selected date/time. So please use it responsibly) 
6. Now you can delete the image from your device. 
7. Make sure to allow the application to send you notifications in order to inform you once the photo has been unlocked and also give permission for the Application to save the unlocked image in your gallery!

All the data are stored locally on your device. You don't need an internet connection or an account.
